node: Sanitation, food-safety, QA, and specialty chemical support
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the sanitation, food-safety, QA, and specialty chemical support node found one obvious reference leader, one less-obvious public audit/brand-standards provider, and two smaller specialty-chemical candidates that require verification of restaurant or foodservice revenue. The strongest directly mapped names are Ecolab for hygiene/sanitation and Rentokil Initial via Steritech for restaurant food-safety and brand-standard assessments. Hawkins and Ascent Industries belong in the underfollowed/speculative lane because they are labeled as specialty chemical or ingredients companies rather than restaurant suppliers; their survival in later layers depends on proving direct exposure to foodservice sanitation, warewash, HI&I, or restaurant QA protocols.
